evidence: All checks run by this reviewer on the frozen bytes (37 files) on 2026-10-02. (1) TOML: Python tomllib loaded task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml without error; criterion counts parsed: gates/render 1, gates/constraints 1, scored/functional 152, scored/polish 5, scored/visual 5. Each [judge] block has judge="claude-code", mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template="prompt.md" (file present beside each judge.toml) and a playwright MCP server; functional alone declares the `verifier` restart server (functional/judge.toml:15-18, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]), which test.sh:193 exports. (2) Shell: `bash -n` succeeded for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh; both start with `#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail`, contain 0 CR bytes, no BOM, end with LF. tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template; so are tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile, tests/scoring.toml, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile. task.toml differs from the template only in the CHANGE_ME identity/metadata lines (diff verified); [verifier.env] and timeouts unchanged. (3) Python: ast.parse OK for tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py (no bytecode written). (4) JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/src/seed_data.json (identical sha256 to the asset) and solution/app/package.json all parse. (5) App entry: test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js and test.sh:97/111 launches `node /app/server.js`; solve.sh copies solution/app/. to /app, which contains server.js (`require('./src/index.js')`). `node --check` (v24.19.0 host) passed for all 9 JS files (server.js, src/{index,bootstrap,db,rules,change-sets}.js, public/js/{app,change-sets,hireops}.js). Every local require resolves to a shipped file (./bootstrap, ./db, ./rules, ./change-sets); the only external packages are express and better-sqlite3, pinned in both Dockerfiles (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1) and reachable via NODE_PATH which test.sh:106 sets. index.html references /styles.css and /js/{hireops,change-sets,app}.js, all present. bootstrap.js:43 listens on PORT||3000 on 0.0.0.0 and answers /api/health before the DB worker, matching the probe at test.sh:48. (6) Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index.json input_sha256 matches the assignment; I recomputed sha256 for all 10 indexed artifacts and every listed matching_source_files hash against the frozen task and all match. The indexed qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-02-live-desk/results/server.log shows `[hireops] listening on 3000` from the frozen solution bytes in the verifier image under uid 65534. Limits of this evidence: I did not start Docker; no full configured verifier/judge launch (test.sh + rewardkit end to end) on these bytes is indexed, so 'would run' for the whole grading pipeline rests on static parsing plus the scripted golden boot, not on a configured judge run. Non-blocking observation outside this row's listed file set: environment/instructions/integration.md is the only file with CRLF endings (19 CR bytes, every line CRLF; template copy is LF, and git records i/crlf w/crlf). It is a Markdown note read by the agent, not a shell script or parsed gating file, so it does not affect parsing or execution; normalising it to LF would be tidy (P3) but changes input bytes.
